## File and location

Path and line range or section reference.

## Issue

Concrete description of the bug: broken link target, formatting that doesn't render, typo in non-frozen prose, cross-reference that no longer resolves, etc.

## Note on FROZEN text

If the bug is in a FROZEN Charter section, fixing it requires the amendment process per [`docs/charter/amendments.md`](../../docs/charter/amendments.md) — even for typos. The path is `editorial fix` per [`amendments.md` §Amendment Discipline](../../docs/charter/amendments.md), recorded in the decision log. State this explicitly so the reporter understands why a one-line fix may take longer than expected.

Reference [`CLAUDE.md` §4](../../.claude/CLAUDE.md) for the current FROZEN/pending status of Charter sections.
